extraction.Name: Alex Labuff
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee, but after refusung for some time, he took it on the advice of the Government Farmer, who told him that he must take it and pay the taxes or he would lose the land and get nothing
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold his land to Smith & Graham, White River, So. Dak. for $5600.00, and they paid me $700.00 and I paid the taxes with it and that was all I got for the land, they never making another payment
extraction.Buyer: Smith & Graham, White River, So. Dak. for $5600.00 (only $700.00 actually paid); also sold 160 acres to a Mr. Chub of Cody Nebr. for $1400.00, half of which had been paid
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes so he sold his land; paid the taxes with the $700.00 he received
extraction.NOTES: Has 160 acres of land remaining at time of affidavit; got a lawyer to fight his case and recovered 480 acres — gave lawyer 160 acres for his work, sold 160 acres to Mr. Chub of Cody, Nebr. for $1400.00 (half paid); has one minor child depending on him for support; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since his patent was issued; mentally competent and in very poor health; affidavit subscribed and sworn November 30, 1928, Shannon County, South Dakota | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
